cohort: 418 healthy pregnant women with a term uncomplicated singleton pregnancy between 37 and 41 weeks of gestation
finding: This study demonstrates that spinal anesthesia is associated with a lower risk of operative blood loss than general anesthesia in low-risk patients undergoing elective CS.
mod_finding: Spinal anesthesia is associated with a lower risk of operative blood loss than general anesthesia in low-risk patients undergoing elective CS.
